summary.text: Stephanie Vargas is the Republican candidate for California's 33rd Congressional District, having placed second in the June 2026 top-two primary. A longtime San Bernardino County resident, she works in the Colton city clerk's office and describes herself as a Christian. The Republican Party of San Bernardino County has endorsed her, and she is running on cost of living, public safety and veterans services.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Vargas says she grew up in San Bernardino and has lived in District 33 her whole life.

According to her iVoterGuide profile, she earned an associate degree in business administration and management from San Bernardino Valley Community College and a certificate through UC Riverside Extension.

Her early work history on that profile includes service as a San Bernardino Police Department police cadet (2010-2013) and Police Explorer (2009-2012), general manager of a Menchie's in Fontana (2014-2016), and community service assistant for the City of Fontana (2016-2018).

Vargas has worked for the City of Colton since 2018, according to iVoterGuide, first as an administrative assistant (2018-2021), then as deputy city clerk (2021-2023), acting city clerk (2023-2024) and chief deputy city clerk (2024-2026).
A voter guide describes her as a chief deputy clerk.
She lists membership in the International Institute of Municipal Clerks and the California Municipal Clerks Association, and board service at Springs Charter School from 2022 to 2026.
This is Vargas's first run for office; iVoterGuide lists no prior political offices held or sought.
She placed second in the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 17.5% of the vote (20,952 votes), and the Republican Party of San Bernardino County has endorsed her.
